indications_and_usage: INDICATIONS & USAGE SECTION Formulated for symptoms associated with food and environmental allergens such as congestion, swollen glands, runny nose, cough, rashes and stomach upset.
dosage_and_administration: DOSAGE & ADMINISTRATION SECTION Directions: Ages 12 and up take 6 drops by mouth (ages 0 to 11, give 3 drops) as needed or directed by a health professional. Sensitive persons begin with 1 drop and gradually increase to full dose.
